entities.summary: Clare H. Torry is an English singer and songwriter, best known for performing on Pink Floyd's song "The Great Gig in the Sky", from their eighth studio album The Dark Side of the Moon (1973). In 2012, readers of Rolling Stone ranked it the second best vocal performance in rock history.
